description_en: Queries the configuration of a TCP listener
name: DescribeLoadBalancerTCPListenerAttribute

parameters.help_en: The listener port to be queried. Valid values: 1 to 65535
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的监听端口。取值：1~65535
parameters.name: listener_port

parameters.help_en: The ID of the load balancing instance
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

BackendServerPort.description_en: The port used by the backend server of the load balancing instance. Valid values: 1 to 65535
BackendServerPort.description_zh: 负载均衡实例后端服务器使用的端口，取值：1~65535

Bandwidth.description_en: The peak bandwidth of the load balancing instance. Default value: -1, which indicates that no bandwidth throttling is applied
Bandwidth.description_zh: 负载均衡带宽峰值，默认值为-1（表示不限速）

EipTransmit.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable EIP pass-through. Valid values:

on: enabled
off (default): disabled
EipTransmit.description_zh:
是否开启EIP透传，取值：

on：开启。
off（默认值）：关闭

EstablishedTimeout.description_en: The connection timeout period. Valid values: 10 to 900. Unit: seconds
EstablishedTimeout.description_zh: 连接超时时间，取值：10~900，单位：秒

HealthCheck.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable the health check feature. Valid values:

on: enabled
off: disabled
HealthCheck.description_zh:
是否开启健康检查。取值：

on：开启。
off：关闭

HealthCheckConnectPort.description_en:
The port used for health checks. Valid values: 1 to 65535. If the Settings for this parameter are not specified, the backend service port (BackendServerPort) is used.
This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
HealthCheckConnectPort.description_zh:
健康检查使用的端口，取值：1~65535。不设置此参数时，表示使用后端服务端口（BackendServerPort）。
HealthCheck值为on时才会有效

HealthCheckConnectTimeout.description_en:
The timeout period for receiving a health check response. If a backend ENS instance does not respond within the specified timeout period, the health check fails.
Default value: 5.
Valid values: 1 to 300.
Unit: seconds.
This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on.
If the value of HealthCheckConnectTimeout is less than the value of HealthCheckInterval, HealthCheckConnectTimeout becomes invalid and the timeout period is the value of HealthCheckInterval
HealthCheckConnectTimeout.description_zh:
接收来自运行状况检查的响应需要等待的时间。如果后端ENS在指定的时间内没有响应，则判定为健康检查失败。
默认值：5秒。
取值：1~300。
单位：秒。
HealthCheck值为on时才会有效。
如果HealthCheckConnectTimeout的值小于HealthCheckInterval的值，则HealthCheckConnectTimeout无效，超时时间为HealthCheckInterval的值

HealthCheckDomain.description_en:
The domain name used for health checks.
This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
HealthCheckDomain.description_zh:
用于健康检查的域名。
HealthCheck值为on时才会有效

HealthCheckHttpCode.description_en:
The HTTP status code that indicates a successful health check. Valid values:

http_2xx (default)
http_3xx
http_4xx
http_5xx

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
HealthCheckHttpCode.description_zh:
健康检查正常时的HTTP状态码。取值：

http_2xx（默认值）。
http_3xx。
http_4xx。
http_5xx。

HealthCheck值为on时才会有效

HealthCheckInterval.description_en: The interval between two consecutive health checks. Valid values: 1 to 50. Unit: seconds
HealthCheckInterval.description_zh: 健康检查的时间间隔。取值：1~50，单位：秒

HealthCheckType.description_en:
The health check type. Valid values:
tcp (default)
http
HealthCheckType.description_zh:
健康检查类型。取值：
tcp（默认值）。
http

HealthCheckURI.description_en:
The URI used for health checks. The URI must be 1 to 80 characters in length.
The URI cannot contain only a forward slash (`/`), but it must start with a forward slash.
This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
HealthCheckURI.description_zh:
用于健康检查的URI。长度限制为1~80。
URL不能只有`/`，但必须以`/`开头。
HealthCheck值为on时才会有效

HealthyThreshold.description_en:
The number of consecutive successful health checks required to change the health check status of a backend server from fail (unreachable) to success (reachable). Valid values: 2 to 10.
This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
HealthyThreshold.description_zh:
健康检查连续成功多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由fail（后台服务器不可达）判定为success（后台服务器可达）。取值：2~10。
HealthCheck值为on时才会有效

ListenerPort.description_en: The frontend port used by the load balancing instance
ListenerPort.description_zh: 负载均衡实例前端使用的端口

PersistenceTimeout.description_en:
The timeout period for session persistence.

Default value: 0, which indicates that session persistence is disabled.
Valid values: 0 to 3600.
Unit: seconds
PersistenceTimeout.description_zh:
会话保持的超时时间。

默认值：0，表示关闭会话保持。
取值：0~3600。
单位：秒

Scheduler.description_en:
The scheduling algorithm. Valid values:
wrr: Backend servers with higher weights are polled more frequently.
wlc: Backend servers are polled based on their weights and actual loads (number of connections). If weights are the same, backend servers with fewer current connections are polled more frequently.
rr: External requests are distributed to backend servers in sequence.
sch: Consistent hashing is based on source IP addresses. Requests from the same source IP address are scheduled to the same backend server.
tch: Consistent hashing is based on quadruples (source IP address, destination IP address, source port, and destination port). Requests from the same stream are scheduled to the same backend server
Scheduler.description_zh:
调度算法。取值：
wrr：权重值越高的后端服务器，被轮询到的次数（概率）也越高。
wlc：除了根据每台后端服务器设定的权重值来进行轮询，同时还考虑后端服务器的实际负载（即连接数）。当权重值相同时，当前连接数越小的后端服务器被轮询到的次数（概率）也越高。
rr：按照访问顺序依次将外部请求依序分发到后端服务器。
sch：基于源IP地址的一致性hash，相同的源地址会调度到相同的后端服务器。
tch：基于四元组的一致性 hash（源 IP+目的 IP+源端口+目的端口），相同的流会调度到相同的后端服务器

Status.description_en:
The status of the listener. Valid values:

Running: running normally
Stopped: stopped
Starting: starting
Configuring: configuring
Stopping: stopping
Status.description_zh:
当前监听的状态。取值：

Running：正常运行。
Stopped：运行停止。
Starting：启动中。
Configuring：配置中。
Stopping：运行停止中

UnhealthyThreshold.description_en:
The number of consecutive failed health checks required to change the health check status of a backend server from success (reachable) to fail (unreachable). Valid values: 2 to 10.

This parameter takes effect only when HealthCheck is set to on
UnhealthyThreshold.description_zh:
健康检查连续失败多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由success（后台服务器可达）判定为fail（后台服务器不可达）。取值：2~10。

HealthCheck值为on时才会有效
